municipality.test: source instance origin lies within municipality polygon including holes

pools.source: Kadaster / PDOK BRT TOP10NL waterdeel_vlak; CC BY 4.0
pools.method: No geometry simplification or minimum water-body area. Municipal land is the exact municipality minus surveyed water. Exclude centres in water and any base within the 9.1 m clearance of a water or municipal boundary. Pool indices reference unchanged source bases. The extra 0.1 m covers local projection and output quantization rounding.

coordinates.source: I3DM ECEF placement/orientation/scale and glTF prototype vertices; all tile/node transforms retained
coordinates.output: glTF X east, Y up, Z south; tileset bounding boxes in Z-up ENU
coordinates.quantization: unsigned 16-bit KHR_mesh_quantization; <=2 cm per axis; actual Euclidean error reported per tile

interpretation.lampHeads: Exact highest transformed prototype vertex along the fixed local vertical, matching the existing native glow anchor. This is a display anchor, not a surveyed light emitter.
interpretation.lampShafts: Illustrative straight connection from source instance origin to the retained head vertex. Does not replace the native curved pole geometry at close range.
interpretation.identifiers: Head mesh extras.sourceIds follow source record order; indexed POSITION vertex 2i is base and 2i+1 is head.
interpretation.sourceDates: Original record dates and attributes remain in cached I3DM batch tables; acquisition date is not an assertion of live/current hardware.
interpretation.gaps: Complete acquisition of all 653 advertised source content tiles, not a claim that every real lamp is present. The source has no leaf coverage at the sampled Maasvlakte point (4.0 E, 51.94 N). No missing placements are invented.
interpretation.precision: Original quantized ECEF coordinates are decoded in double precision before local quantization. The native browser I3DM loader first converts ECEF to Float32, introducing roughly decimetre placement rounding that is not reproduced here.
interpretation.duplicates: Remove only records with identical source identifier, instance origin and transformed top vertex.
